up: Retrieve activity measurements for compounds tested against the human TGF-beta receptor type I (CHEMBL4439). Return one row per activity with these exact columns: compound_chembl_id (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), canonical_smiles (compound_structures.canonical_smiles), compound_key (compound_records.compound_key), pubmed_id_or_doi (COALESCE(docs.pubmed_id, docs.doi)), assay_description (assays.description), standard_type (activities.standard_type), standard_relation (activities.standard_relation), standard_value (activities.standard_value), standard_units (activities.standard_units), activity_comment (activities.activity_comment), target_name (target_dictionary.pref_name), and organism (target_dictionary.organism). Apply filters: activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.standard_units = 'nM', target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4439', compound_structures.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL, and (docs.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR docs.doi IS NOT NULL). Join activities to compound_records on record_id, compound_records to molecule_dictionary on molregno, molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno, activities to docs on doc_id, activities to assays on assay_id, and assays to target_dictionary on tid. Do not limit the number of rows returned.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles, cr.compound_key AS compound_key, COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi, ass.description AS assay_description, act.standard_type AS standard_type, act.standard_relation AS standard_relation, act.standard_value AS standard_value, act.standard_units AS standard_units, act.activity_comment AS activity_comment, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS organism FROM activities act JOIN compound_records cr ON act.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN docs d ON act.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assays ass ON act.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid WHERE act.standard_type = 'IC50' AND act.standard_units = 'nM' AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4439' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL)
